title: SPAR Math Adapter Subject
description: Structured subject payload for the spar_domain_math proof claim-drift adapter.

theorem_id.description: Identifier for the theorem or result (e.g. thm-1, lemma-2)

domain.description: Mathematical domain (e.g. topology, algebra, analysis, combinatorics)

proof_claimed.description: Author claims a complete or partial proof is provided

generality_claimed.description: Author claims the result holds under general or broad conditions

novelty_claimed.description: Author claims the result is new or original

proof_status.description: Evidence level of the proof: complete proof, proof sketch, or no proof present

assumptions_explicit.description: Whether the boundary conditions and assumptions are explicitly stated

prior_art_cited.description: Whether relevant prior work is cited
